However, it was very different 500 years ago, 2,000 years ago or even 5,000 years ago. This region of the world, which we often call the ‘Indian Subcontinent’, has had many different names and shifting boundaries. We can learn about India’s past and evolution from many different sources. THINK ABOUT IT Consider the physical map of the Indian Subcontinent at the start of the chapter.
